description: Assess whether a Norwegian company qualifies as *foretak i vanskeligheter* (a 'company in difficulty') under EU GBER art. 2(18) criteria a-e. Assessed at BOTH company and group level, as EU/EFTA state-aid practice requires — a company with clean accounts is in difficulty when its group is. Returns which criteria triggered, the overall status, the group assessment, and a data-completeness confidence score — a deterministic distress classification, not a raw registry flag. Use for EU state-aid eligibility, credit assessment, and supplier-risk screening.
name: firmaradar_check_foretak_i_vanskeligheter

footnote.description: Mandatory qualification when qualification_status is present, including open-data, group-level and rescuable verdicts.
footnote.title: Footnote

has_caveat.description: Whether the label carries the open-data (*) marker. This is distinct from whether another material qualification is required.
has_caveat.title: Has Caveat

qualification_status.description: Whether this verdict requires no qualification or carries the required qualification. A missing required qualification rejects the entire presentation instead of producing this object.
qualification_status.title: Qualification Status

basis.description: Data basis: konsernregnskap (filed consolidated accounts), aggregert_selskapsregnskap (individual accounts summed arithmetically — indicative, intra-group balances are not eliminated), utenlandsk_majoritet or ingen_data.
basis.title: Basis

capital_loss_ratio.description: Share of the group's subscribed capital lost to accumulated losses.
capital_loss_ratio.title: Capital Loss Ratio

evaluated.description: False when the company is not part of any group.
evaluated.title: Evaluated

has_public_controller.description: True if the root of the >50%-control ownership tree is an unambiguous public-sector entity (§16-40-5(4)) — disqualifies SMB status regardless of size.
has_public_controller.title: Has Public Controller

public_controller_unknown.description: True when the root is missing among the classified members, or its org_form is unknown — has_public_controller=False then does NOT confirm the root is private, only that it isn't known.
public_controller_unknown.title: Public Controller Unknown

root_distressed.description: Whether the group head itself is in difficulty. Null means its status could not be established; false means established and healthy.
root_distressed.title: Root Distressed

root_org_form.description: The root member's raw BRREG org_form code (before normalization), or null if unknown. Exposed for transparency/debugging.
root_org_form.title: Root Org Form

size_ansatte_complete.description: False until period-aligned annual work units are available; current BRREG headcount is not a complete employee measure.
size_ansatte_complete.title: Size Ansatte Complete

size_ansatte_sum.description: Sum over the >50%-control ownership tree (§16-40-5(2)-(3)); null when no member reported this field.
size_ansatte_sum.title: Size Ansatte Sum

size_balansesum_complete.description: True when the selected value comes from a usable filed consolidated statement, or every evaluated member reported this field and the tree was not truncated — otherwise it is an incomplete subtotal, not threshold evidence.
size_balansesum_complete.title: Size Balansesum Complete

size_balansesum_sum_nok.description: NOK balance-sheet-total sum over the >50%-control ownership tree (§16-40-5(2)-(3)); null when no member reported this field.
size_balansesum_sum_nok.title: Size Balansesum Sum Nok

size_driftsinntekter_complete.description: True when the selected value comes from a usable filed consolidated statement, or every evaluated member reported this field and the tree was not truncated — otherwise it is an incomplete subtotal, not threshold evidence.
size_driftsinntekter_complete.title: Size Driftsinntekter Complete

size_driftsinntekter_sum_nok.description: NOK revenue sum over the >50%-control ownership tree (§16-40-5(2)-(3)); null when no member reported this field.
size_driftsinntekter_sum_nok.title: Size Driftsinntekter Sum Nok

size_sum_is_consolidated.description: True only if both revenue and balance-sheet totals come from a filed consolidated (regnskapstype=KONSERN) statement, already eliminated by an auditor — false means at least one naive standalone-account sum may overstate the group's size due to non-eliminated intra-group transactions.
size_sum_is_consolidated.title: Size Sum Is Consolidated

status.description: Group-level outcome: clean, distressed, doubt or unknown. 'unknown' means the group could not be assessed (typically a foreign parent, which does not exist as an entity in Norwegian registries).
status.title: Status

RescueEstimate.description: Hva konsernet må tilføre for å fjerne kapitalkriteriet (a).

frist.description: Deadline — no later than the point the aid is granted.
frist.title: Frist

konsernbidrag_min_nok.description: Minimum group contribution / grant, in NOK.
konsernbidrag_min_nok.title: Konsernbidrag Min Nok

RescueEstimate.title: RescueEstimate

classifier_version.description: Immutable version stamp for the FIV rule set used.
classifier_version.title: Classifier Version

classifier_version_sequence.description: Authoritative monotonic ordering key for classifier_version; compare this field, not the version string, to order rule sets.
classifier_version_sequence.title: Classifier Version Sequence

company_status.description: The company-level result alone, before the group level was applied.
company_status.title: Company Status

distress_basis.description: Which level makes the company distressed: company, group or company_and_group. Null when not distressed.
distress_basis.title: Distress Basis

rescuable_by_group.description: True when the group can lift the company out of difficulty by injecting capital before the aid is granted.
rescuable_by_group.title: Rescuable By Group

status.description: One of: not_distressed, insufficient_data, not_distressed_partial, exempt_young_company, distressed. Reflects BOTH levels of the assessment — a company with clean accounts is 'distressed' when its group is.
status.title: Status

verdict.description: Deprecated display label retained for backwards compatibility. Use verdict_presentation for the qualified label and mandatory caveat. Scheduled for removal in firmaradar-mcp 0.8.0, after the structured replacement has been available throughout the 0.7.x release line.
verdict.title: Verdict

verdict_presentation.description: Qualified display verdict. Label and mandatory caveat footnote travel as one object; a caveated 'No (*)' is never returned without its text.
